"""Shapes for the floor-plan estimator."""

import math


class Circle:
    name = "circle"

    def __init__(self, radius):
        self.radius = radius

    def area(self):
        return math.pi * self.radius ** 2

    def perimeter(self):
        return 2 * math.pi * self.radius

    def describe(self, unit="m"):
        area = round(self.area(), 2)
        perimeter = round(self.perimeter(), 2)
        ratio = round(area / perimeter, 3) if perimeter else 0.0
        label = self.name.capitalize()
        return f"{label}: area {area} {unit}^2, perimeter {perimeter} {unit}, ratio {ratio}"


class Rectangle:
    name = "rectangle"

    def __init__(self, width, height):
        self.width = width
        self.height = height

    def area(self):
        return self.width * self.height

    def perimeter(self):
        return 2 * (self.width + self.height)

    def describe(self, unit="m"):
        area = round(self.area(), 2)
        perimeter = round(self.perimeter(), 2)
        ratio = round(area / perimeter, 3) if perimeter else 0.0
        label = self.name.capitalize()
        return f"{label}: area {area} {unit}^2, perimeter {perimeter} {unit}, ratio {ratio}"
